content:
# Slack Modal — Progress Notes

## Phase 3 / fix-builder — 2026-04-30

Branch: `fix-modal-titles-and-options` (off `feature/slack-modal` @ `e6e741b`)

### Operator manual-test failure (root cause)

`/runway-new-task my new task` against ngrok dev returned "did not respond". Slack
WebClient errors:

- `view.title.text` "must be less than 25 characters" — `Review and save - new task` is 26 chars.
- `view.blocks[9].accessory.options` "must provide at least 1 items" — resources Name picker rendered as `static_select` with `options: []`.

### Fixes applied

1. **Title length** — Shortened all four create headers in `src/lib/slack/modals/copy.ts`:
   - `Review and save - new project` (29) → `New project` (11)
   - `Review and save - new retainer` (30) → `New retainer` (12)
   - `Review and save - new task` (26) → `New task` (8)
   - `Review and save - new team member` (33) → `New team member` (15)
   Edit headers (`Edit X - {name}`) already truncate via builder helpers; added
   the same `truncateTitle` helper to `team-member.ts` (was missing).
2. **Block 9 fix (Option A — switch to `external_select`)** — In both
   `task.ts` and `project.ts`, the resources Name accessory was a
   `static_select` with `options: initialName ? [...] : []`. Slack rejects
   empty options arrays, so any first-row create modal failed. Switched to
   `external_select` with `min_query_length: 0` — typeahead from the
   server's options-provider endpoint. `initial_option` round-trip preserved
   for edit-mode pre-fill. Same fix shape on both files.

### Block index of failure

In production (`baselineHint` enabled, no errorBlock, no multiMatchHint) the
block ordering on the task modal is:

```
0  client_block
1  baseline_hint_block       ← from baselineHint
2  parent_project_block
3  title_block
4  category_block
5  date_type_block
6  date_block
7  owner_block
8  resources_block_0         (role accessory)
9  resources_name_block_0    (NAME accessory — empty options array)
```

The reproducer test (no baselineHint) saw this same block at index 8.
Both prove the same root cause.

### Tests added

- `task.test.ts`, `project.test.ts`, `team-member.test.ts` — title-length
  guard for every (mode, retainerMode) combo with both short and 100-char
  entity names; empty-options recursive walker that fails on any
  `static_select` with `options.length === 0`.
- `copy.test.ts` — locked the new shorter strings + added a `<25` length
  assertion for every create header.

### Verification

- `pnpm test:run` — 2725 passed, 19 skipped, 0 failed.
- `pnpm lint` — 0 errors, 10 pre-existing warnings (none in touched files).
- Em-dash grep guard on `copy.ts` still passes; no em-dashes introduced.

### Out-of-scope (not changed)

- `tests/fixtures/slack/view-*.json` still carry the placeholder string
  `"Review and save"` — these fixtures simulate Slack-echoed payloads on the
  view-submission path, and no test asserts on `view.title.text` from them.
  Leaving as-is; can be backfilled later for fidelity if anyone reads them.
- The route-handler `handleCreate` in `src/app/api/slack/commands/route.ts`
  needed no changes — Option B was unnecessary because Option A (typeahead
  via `external_select`) is the right fit for a workspace-scoped, dynamic
  team-member list.
- Other static_select dropdowns (status, category, date_type radio,
  resources_role, role_category) all have non-empty hardcoded option lists
  in source and were already safe; the new guard tests cover them as a
  regression net.
